content.short: A groundbreaking SocialFi platform that enables users to tokenize their social influence through profile "keys."
content.description:
Friend.tech is a SocialFi platform on the Base network that tokenizes social influence through profile "keys." It allows users to buy and sell keys of creators, granting unique privileges like direct messaging and exclusive chat access. This creates a direct economic link between influencers and followers, incentivizing high-quality engagement.

Leveraging the Base L2, Friend.tech provides a seamless social experience with low costs. By integrating decentralized identity, it offers new ways for creators to monetize work and for users to invest in social value.
content.meta: Tokenize your social influence on Friend.tech. Buy and sell creator keys to access exclusive chats and direct engagement on Base.
